Package httyd.model.item

Class Item

java.lang.Object
httyd.model.item.Item
Direct Known Subclasses:
BuffItem, CleanseItem, HealItem, ReloadItem
public abstract class Item extends Object
Base class of all trainer items. A subclass decides what use(httyd.battle.Combatant, httyd.battle.BattleLog) does; the battle engine only calls use and never checks which kind of item it is (polymorphism).

    • isUseful

      public boolean isUseful(Combatant target)
      Tells whether using the item now would change anything. The engine refuses useless items so a turn is never wasted by mistake.
      Parameters:
      target - the dragon on the field
      Returns:
      true if the item would have an effect
